}

country_event = {
	id = nsr.301
	title = nsr.301.t
	desc = nsr.301.d
	picture = GFX_report_event_generic_battle
	is_triggered_only = yes
	option = {
		name = nsr.301.a
		ai_chance = { factor = 1 }
		add_stability = 0.02
		if = {
			limit = { has_power_balance = { id = NSR_shura_bop } }
			add_power_balance_value = { id = NSR_shura_bop value = -0.05 tooltip_side = NSR_bop_tamkin }
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = nsr.301.b
		ai_chance = { factor = 2 }
		army_experience = 10
		if = {
			limit = { has_power_balance = { id = NSR_shura_bop } }
			add_power_balance_value = { id = NSR_shura_bop value = 0.05 tooltip_side = NSR_bop_jihad }
		}
	}
}

country_event = {
	id = nsr.302
	title = nsr.302.t
	desc = nsr.302.d
	picture = GFX_report_event_british_inspect_troops
	is_triggered_only = yes
	trigger = {
		NOT = { has_global_flag = NSR_london_decided }
		any_country = { has_country_flag = NSR_loyalist_side exists = yes }
	}
	option = {
		name = nsr.302.a
		ai_chance = {
			factor = 3
			modifier = { factor = 2 NSR = { has_country_flag = NSR_warned_london } }
			modifier = { factor = 0.5 any_country = { has_country_flag = NSR_l_appealed_to_london } }
		}
		set_global_flag = NSR_london_decided
		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = NSR }
			NSR = { country_event = { id = nsr.311 days = 1 } }
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = nsr.302.b
		ai_chance = { factor = 1 }
		set_global_flag = NSR_london_decided
		set_global_flag = NSR_london_backs_sultan
		custom_effect_tooltip = NSR_tt_london_backs
		hidden_effect = {
			random_country = {
				limit = {
					has_country_flag = NSR_loyalist_side
					exists = yes
				}
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = infantry_equipment amount = 1500 }
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_idea = NSR_gibraltar_supply_line } }
					add_ideas = NSR_gibraltar_supply_line
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = NSR }
			NSR = { country_event = { id = nsr.312 days = 1 } }
		}
	}
}

	desc = nsr.303.d
	picture = GFX_report_event_generic_sign_treaty1
	is_triggered_only = yes

		NOT = { has_global_flag = NSR_spain_decided }
		NOT = { original_tag = NSR }
		any_country = { has_country_flag = NSR_loyalist_side exists = yes }
	}
	option = {
		name = nsr.303.a
		ai_chance = {
			factor = 3
			modifier = { factor = 2 NSR = { has_country_flag = NSR_word_to_spaniards } }
			modifier = { factor = 2 has_war = yes }
		}
		set_global_flag = NSR_spain_decided
		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = NSR }
			NSR = { country_event = { id = nsr.313 days = 1 } }
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = nsr.303.b
		ai_chance = { factor = 1 }
		set_global_flag = NSR_spain_decided
		add_state_claim = 169
		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = NSR }
			NSR = { country_event = { id = nsr.314 days = 1 } }
		}
	}
}

		navy_experience = 25
		add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = convoy_1 amount = 10 }
		custom_effect_tooltip = NSR_tt_cadiz_mutiny

				limit = {
					has_country_flag = NSR_loyalist_side
					exists = yes
				}
				add_ideas = NSR_mutiny_at_cadiz
			}
		}
	}

		name = nsr.304.b

		}
	}
}
